scheme_name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Swachhta Udyami Yojana – Swachhta Se Sampannta Ki Aur
other_conditions: Must be a Safai Karamchari (including waste‑pickers), a manual scavenger, or a dependent of a manual scavenger
Must belong to a registered co‑operative society or a legally constituted association/firm of the target group

Must produce a certificate from an authorized local official such as a Revenue Officer, Municipal Officer, Cantonment Executive Officer, Railway Officer, or a Gazetted‑rank head of a government department, elected municipal member, Gram Panchayat Pradhan, or Regional Manager of an RRB/PSB
If identified as a manual scavenger in the 2013 MS Act survey, the certificate is not required once the name appears in the final state/UT manual scavenger list
An occupation certificate may be issued by the Mukhia/Sarpanch/President or any equivalent authority of the Gram Panchayat for Safai Karamchari or their dependents
benefits_summary: Term loan up to Rs 50 lacs at 4 % interest (with 1 % rebate for women and 0.5 % rebate for timely repayment) plus a capital subsidy of up to 50 % of the vehicle cost.
documents_required: Certificate from local Revenue Officer/ Municipal Officer/ Cantonment Executive Officer/ Railway Officer/ Head of Government Department
Occupation certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat head (Mukhia/Sarpanch/President) or equivalent authority
